_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Louise Seymour Houghton (1838-1920): Sabatier's Life of St. Francis of Assisi (1894), Bordeaux's The House (1914) and Boylesve's You No Longer Count (1918). Her Russian Grandmother's Wonder Tales is on Lane D's louise-houghton_shelf.json; this shelf holds her other translations and could merge into that one. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 37); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
